_comment: Gap manifest for assets/grocery/. One entry per icon that does not exist yet. `file` must keep its category's shared underscore-prefix, because lib/data/grocery_catalog.dart derives the English label by stripping it (sharedFilePrefix). `de` is the German label, the one thing the catalog cannot infer. `subject` is the only part of the image prompt that varies; the style half lives in generate.dart. `ref` picks the style-reference trio.
